lines.en: label nodokafirsthall:
scene nodokahall1
: Oh. Well, hello there.
lines.zh: : 哦。哎呀，你好啊。

lines.en: : To what do I owe the pleasure, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 是什么风把你吹来了，Sensei？

lines.en: : No pleasure involved, just here to kill some time.
lines.zh: : 没什么风，只是来消磨时间的。

lines.en: : No pleasure involved? Not even a little bit?
lines.zh: : 没什么风？一点点都没有？

lines.en: : I mean...if you want there to be pleasure...
lines.zh: : 我是说……要是你想让这里有点风的话……

lines.en: scene nodokahall2
: Of course I want there to be pleasure.
lines.zh: : 我当然想让这里有点什么。

lines.en: : Why else would I have this word-coated rectangular object in my hands?
lines.zh: : 不然我手里拿着这个涂满文字的长方形物体干什么？

lines.en: : Weird way to say “book” but okay.
lines.zh: : 「书」这个名字挺怪的，不过行吧。

lines.en: : What I mean to ask is why bother indulging yourself in anything if there is nothing to leech from it?
lines.zh: : 我想问的是，如果一样东西里榨不出任何东西，那还费劲去沉溺其中干什么？

lines.en: : We are all but leeches, Sensei. Digging our tiny, jagged teeth into anything they’ll latch onto in search of the essence of life.
lines.zh: : 我们不过都是些水蛭罢了，Sensei。把细小而参差的牙齿咬进任何咬得住的东西里，寻找生命的精华。

lines.en: : Weird way to say “blood” but okay again.
lines.zh: : 「血」这个名字也挺怪的，不过还是行吧。

lines.en: scene nodokahall3
: Would you at least agree that words without experience are meaningless?
lines.zh: : 至少你会同意吧——没有经验支撑的文字是没有意义的？

lines.en: : It’s something that appeared inside of this very rectangle and I’d be a liar if I were to say it didn’t provoke some impure thoughts in this old noggin of mine.
lines.zh: : 这句话就出现在这个长方形的某一页里。要是我说它没在我这颗老脑筋里勾起些不纯洁的念头，那我就是在撒谎。

lines.en: : You’re still in [high_school]. Your noggin is absolutely not “old.”
lines.zh: : 你还在上 [high_school]。你的脑筋绝对算不上「老」。

lines.en: : No, it is not.
lines.zh: : 是啊，算不上。

lines.en: : But that calls into question exactly why I am reading this specific piece of literature despite having no experience in its subject matter.
lines.zh: : 但这就引出问题了——既然我对这个题材毫无经验，我为什么偏偏在读这篇特定的文学作品？

lines.en: : If words without experience are meaningless, shouldn’t these words, which I have no experience with, simply bounce off the walls of my brain without so much as leaving a minor bruise?
lines.zh: : 如果没有经验支撑的文字没有意义，那这些我毫无经验的文字，难道不该只是从我脑壁上弹开，连块小淤青都不留吗？

lines.en: : Can brains even bruise?
lines.zh: : 大脑还会淤青吗？

lines.en: : Probably? I can’t imagine it would feel very nice, though.
lines.zh: : 大概会吧？不过我想那感觉肯定不怎么好。

lines.en: : What are you reading anyway?
lines.zh: : 你到底在读什么？

lines.en: scene nodokahall4
: “Lolita.” Are you familiar with it?
lines.zh: : 《Lolita》。你熟悉吗？

lines.en: : Vaguely. I feel like I read that a long time ago but I’m kind of hazy on the details.
lines.zh: : 模模糊糊。感觉很久以前读过，但细节已经很模糊了。

lines.en: : I’m not surprised you’ve read it given your...demeanor so far.
lines.zh: : 考虑到你到目前为止的……举止，你读过我倒不意外。

lines.en: : I’m sure the title itself is enough to give you an inkling of what the subject matter is, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我相信，光是书名就足够让你猜到题材是什么了。

lines.en: : Sexual conduct is one thing, but do you believe you’d ever be able to fall in love with someone so much younger than you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 性行为是一回事，但你觉得你有朝一日会爱上一个比你小那么多的人吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I prefer not discussing love whenever possible. It’s not exactly a cut and dry topic.
lines.zh: : 能不谈爱我就不谈。这话题可没那么黑白分明。

lines.en: : Do you think you’d ever be able to love someone so much older?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得你会爱上一个比你大那么多的人吗？

lines.en: scene nodokahall5
: I also prefer not discussing love whenever possible.
lines.zh: : 我也是，能不谈爱就不谈。

lines.en: : It’s not exactly a cut and dry topic.
lines.zh: : 这话题可没那么黑白分明。

lines.en: : I do yearn for the taboo, though. But I’m pretty sure the whole [incest] thing gave that away.
lines.zh: : 不过我确实渴望禁忌。但我想那个 [incest] 的事早就把这点暴露了。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’ve come across as kind of...freaky so far.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你到目前为止给人的感觉是有点……怪。

lines.en: : I do? Whatever do you mean?
lines.zh: : 我吗？此话怎讲？

lines.en: : I’m but an inexperienced, [adolescent] leech whose teeth aren’t sharp enough to latch onto anything.
lines.zh: : 我不过是个毫无经验的、[adolescent] 的水蛭，牙齿还不够尖，咬不住任何东西。

lines.en: : Perhaps I could try to take a bite out of you, Sensei? For practice.
lines.zh: : 或许我可以试着在你身上咬一口，Sensei？就当练练手。

lines.en: : Like, right now?
lines.zh: : 就，现在？

lines.en: : Just a little nibble. Quickly, before Uta sees us.
lines.zh: : 就轻轻一小口。快点，趁 Uta 还没看见。

lines.en: : That book is really getting to you, huh?
lines.zh: : 那本书对你的影响真够大的，是吧？

lines.en: scene nodokahall6
: It is.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : I’m very easily fascinated by things most people aren’t able to experience in their own lives.
lines.zh: : 我太容易被大多数人一生都体验不到的东西迷住了。

lines.en: : Though, I suppose the idea of an illicit and inappropriate relationship may be a bit more common than I thought prior to attending [kumon_mi_high].
lines.zh: : 不过，我想那种禁忌而不伦的关系，可能比我入学 [kumon_mi_high] 之前以为的要常见些。

lines.en: : So, yes. I can’t help but feel my heart begin to race at the thought of something like that.
lines.zh: : 所以，没错。一想到那样的事，我就忍不住心跳加速。

lines.en: : Maybe I’ll give it another go soon. It’s been a while since I’ve read anything, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 也许我该找个时间再读一遍。说实话，我已经很久没读过东西了。

lines.en: : That’s a shame. Literature can be a portal to different worlds and different lives.
lines.zh: : 那太遗憾了。文学可以是通往不同世界、不同人生的一扇门。

lines.en: : Your time would likely be better spent on literature you’re not currently living through, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你的时间大概更适合花在你目前还没亲身经历过的那种文学上。

lines.en: : Are you suggesting something about me, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 你这是在暗示我什么吗，Nodoka？

lines.en: : If not suggesting, then recommending...as you have more than a handful of opportunities at your disposal.
lines.zh: : 如果不是暗示，那就是建议……毕竟你手边的机会可不止一两个。

lines.en: : You’ve already confirmed some of your thoughts on the topic of manipulation. Surely you don’t only use that tactic for little, white lies.
lines.zh: : 你已经承认过自己对「操控」的一些看法。你总不至于只在那些无伤大雅的小谎上用这招吧。

lines.en: : Is this your attempt at manipulating me?
lines.zh: : 这就是你试图操控我的方式？

lines.en: : What would I possibly manipulate you into doing that you wouldn’t already do on your own?
lines.zh: : 我有什么好操控你去做的，是你自己本来就不会去做的事吗？

lines.en: : Reading more books.
lines.zh: : 多读书。

lines.en: scene nodokahall7
: Ahh, yes. The consumption of knowledge has become more taboo than any illicit relationship out there.
lines.zh: : 啊，是啊。获取知识已经变得比世上任何不伦关系都要禁忌了。

lines.en: : It’s certainly starting to feel like that, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少感觉上确实开始是这样了。

lines.en: scene nodokahall8
: I’m surprised you’ve managed to go so long without diving into a word-maze, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我挺惊讶你居然能这么久没一头扎进文字迷宫里。

lines.en: : Jesus, Nodoka. Just use the word “book.”
lines.zh: : 天啊，Nodoka。直接用「书」这个字行不行。

lines.en: : Well now I’m just going to continue abstaining out of sheer spite.
lines.zh: : 那现在我就偏要继续戒着，纯粹是为了跟你赌气。

lines.en: : Of course you are...
lines.zh: : 你当然会了……

lines.en: : Futaba tells me you used to be a writer, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Futaba 跟我说你以前是个作家，Sensei。

lines.en: : Why is it that you’ve given up on that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么放弃了？

lines.en: : At this point, my brain is so all over the place that I feel like anything I write would come out twisted and indiscernible.
lines.zh: : 到了这个地步，我的脑子乱成一团，我觉得我写出来的任何东西都会是扭曲而难以辨认的。

lines.en: : So what? You should know better than anyone that the overflow of creative juices can lead to all sorts of amazing things.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？你应该比谁都清楚，创意的汁液满溢出来能催生各种美妙的东西。

lines.en: : So can the overflow of less creative juices.
lines.zh: : 不够有创意的汁液满溢出来也能。

lines.en: : Please explain to me in detail exactly which juices you are referring to, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那就请你详细地给我解释一下，你指的到底是哪种汁液，Sensei。

lines.en: : Quickly, before Uta hears us and has to call her parents.
lines.zh: : 快点，趁 Uta 还没听见，还没到要打电话叫她爸妈的地步。

lines.en: : You know about the parent thing too?
lines.zh: : 爸妈那件事你也知道？

lines.en: : I do. And your response has consequently confirmed that you’ve been involved in at least one sexual conversation with her.
lines.zh: : 我知道。而你的反应顺带确认了你至少跟她进行过一次涉及性的对话。

lines.en: : Nice.
lines.zh: : 不错。

lines.en: : She’s an overly flirtatious part-time maid. It would be more surprising if I didn’t find myself in a conversation like that with her at least once.
lines.zh: : 她是个过分爱调情的兼职女仆。要是我从没跟她聊过一次那种天，那才叫奇怪。

lines.en: : Ooooooh and you like maids as well.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦哦，你还喜欢女仆啊。

lines.en: : We should go to the cafe together sometime and prey upon those innocent girls.
lines.zh: : 我们该找个时间一起去那家咖啡厅，捕食那些无辜的女孩。

lines.en: : Think of how many soft, slender necks we could dig our teeth into.
lines.zh: : 想想看，我们能咬进多少柔软纤细的脖子里。

lines.en: : My [niece] works at that cafe, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 我的 [niece] 就在那家咖啡厅工作，Nodoka。

lines.en: scene nodokahall9
: Sensei...you’re really trying to excite me now, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : Sensei……你现在是真的很想让我兴奋起来，对吧？

lines.en: : I feel like you are very easily excited.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你太容易兴奋了。

lines.en: : But not very easily satisfied.
lines.zh: : 但不太容易满足。

lines.en: : Remember that when the time comes for you to become my own Humbert Humbert.
lines.zh: : 等到你成为属于我的 Humbert Humbert 的那天，请记住这一点。

lines.en: scene nodokahall10
: Until then, though, I suppose I will continue to live inside of paper.
lines.zh: : 不过在那之前，我想我会继续活在纸里。

lines.en: : Wait. I don’t remember much of “Lolita,” but I’m pretty sure I’m already that Humbert guy.
lines.zh: : 等等。《Lolita》我记不太清了，但我很确定我已经是那个 Humbert 了。

lines.en: : We’re not at that part of the novel yet, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我们还没读到小说里的那部分呢，Sensei。

lines.en: : But perhaps, somewhere, some day, at a less miserable time, we may see each other again.
lines.zh: : 不过，也许在某个地方、某一天，在一个不那么悲惨的时刻，我们会再相见。

lines.en: : Goodnight.
lines.zh: : 晚安。

lines.en: scene nodokahall11
Nodoka goes back into her room and leaves me standing in the hall, bewildered and mildly aroused.
lines.zh: Nodoka 回了自己的房间，把我一个人留在走廊里，困惑又有点兴奋。

lines.en: That’s pretty much how half of our conversations end, though, so I’m not too shocked by it.
lines.zh: 不过我们一半的对话差不多都是这么结束的，所以我也不太惊讶。

lines.en: scene black
Either way, I decide to simply go home and rest.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我决定干脆回家休息。

lines.en: But not until after knocking on her door several times to see if she was ready to skip further into our novel together.
lines.zh: 但在那之前，我敲了她好几次门，想看看她有没有准备好跟我一起把我们的小说往后翻。

lines.zh: Nodoka 的好感度提升到了 [nodoka_love]！
